name: Design Gallery Interface
aliases: Design Gallery Interface — A general user interface for computer graphics applications that provides a gallery of predefined transfer functions, allowing users to pick features of interest from the gallery and refine them
Design Gallery Interface — Design Galleries, Design Galleries (Marks et al.)
definition: A general user interface for computer graphics applications that provides a gallery of predefined transfer functions, allowing users to pick features of interest from the gallery and refine them.
summary: The Design Gallery Interface presents a gallery of predefined transfer functions, distinguishing itself by abstracting high-dimensional spaces into discrete visualizations to reduce user effort.
